info.name: Initialize a general file upload (get presigned PUT URL)

params.name: entityId
params.description: The UUID of the Platform entity

items.docs: Creates a po_attachments row with purpose=GENERAL, upload_status=INITIATED and returns a presigned S3 PUT URL. Client uploads the file directly to S3 via the presigned URL. For Terms & Conditions uploads use POST /terms/attachments/upload instead.

info.name: Complete a file upload (confirm S3 object)

params.name: entityId
params.description: The UUID of the Platform entity

items.docs: Client calls this after uploading to S3. If success=true (default), server verifies the S3 object exists via HeadObject and transitions INITIATED → UPLOADED. If success=false, server transitions INITIATED → FAILED (client-signaled failure). For T&C uploads use POST /terms/attachments/:attachmentId/complete (stricter auth).

info.name: Get a presigned download URL for an attachment

params.name: entityId
params.description: The UUID of the Platform entity

items.docs: Returns a short-lived presigned S3 GET URL with Content-Disposition. The client fetches the URL directly from S3. Soft-deleted attachments and non-UPLOADED rows return 404.

params.name: entityId
params.description: The UUID of the Platform entity

items.docs: Soft-deletes the attachment. If standalone (not linked to a comment), the associated activity log entry is hidden. If linked to a comment, the comment remains visible. General attachments: uploader-only. T&C attachments: PO Editor. PO must not be in a terminal status.

params.name: entityId
params.description: The UUID of the Platform entity

items.docs: Soft-deletes and removes S3 objects for multiple unlinked attachments in a single request. Only attachments owned by the caller that are not yet linked to a comment or group are eligible. Silently skips ineligible IDs. Used by the frontend to clean up abandoned uploads.

info.name: List attachments for a PO, grouped by purpose

params.name: entityId
params.description: The UUID of the Platform entity

items.docs: Returns all attachments in uploadStatus IN ('ATTACHED', 'UPLOADED') for the PO, grouped into `general` and `termsAndConditions` arrays (newest first within each). `storageKey` is omitted from each item (internal). Used by the frontend Copy-PO flow and attachment tiles to avoid walking the activity feed.
